LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: A single player's unified global leaderboard entry storing their unique nickname, highest flip count, and rank tier.

playerId.description: Unique client-generated player identifier ensuring one ranking entry per user.

nicknameKey.description: Lowercased canonical nickname used for case-insensitive duplicate prevention.

bestFlips.description: Player's highest number of tile flips achieved in a 60-second match.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update.

NicknameLock.title: NicknameLock
NicknameLock.description: Atomic uniqueness lock mapping a canonical lowercased nickname to a single playerId.

nickname.description: Display casing of the claimed nickname.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the nickname was claimed.

/leaderboard/{playerId}.description: Unified global leaderboard entries keyed by playerId so each player holds at most one ranking.

/nicknames/{nicknameKey}.description: Uniqueness index keyed by lowercased nickname to prevent duplicate nicknames across players.
